content.text:
Sailing Leaf is like a small boat placed at home, carrying the love between humans and pets. At the front we can plant climbers. At the rear we can place our beloved pets. Along the support, new life grows like a sail, as dusk comes and goes, end to end, sails away.

一葉小舟放置家中，承載著人類與寵物間的愛。前端種植爬藤植物，後方安置我們心愛的寵物，順著支架新生命如帆般生長，暮去朝來，首尾相接，揚帆啟航。

Background | Can death be beautiful? Can love be continued?
Pets are considered as family members just like children. However, their lives are much shorter than ours. When our pets pass away, many of us may be the first time to experience death. So can death be beautiful? Can love be continued?  By becoming a decoration and a planting vessel, Sailing Leaf hopes that death will no longer be cold and untalkable, but will continue the love of the past with the beauty of new life.

寵物就像孩子一樣是家庭成員之一，然而他們的生命卻比人類成員短暫太多，在寵物離開我們時多數人可能是第一次面對死亡，那麼能否讓死亡變得美好？我們的愛又是否能夠長存？  通過成為家中擺飾，同時化身為種植容器，「一葉舟」希望死亡不再是冰冷的，也不再是被避而不談的，而是將過往的愛以新生命的美好繼續延續。

Inspiration

The ancients said "fallen leaves return to the roots". Moreover, in the ancient legends of various cultures, the end of life often involves rivers: The River of Forgetfulness in Chinese culture; Sanzu no Kawa in Japanese culture; ​the Styx River in Greek mythology; Gjöll in Norse mythology; ​the Hubur River in Mesopotamia; Hiṭpun in Mandaean;  ​and the Kalunga Line in Congo.
Therefore, the shape of Sailing Leaf is superimposed with the image of leaves and boats, overlooking as a piece of leaf, front look as a sailing boat.

古人道「鳥倦舊巢葉歸根」；而且在各個文化的古老傳說中，對於生命盡頭的描述離不開河流，東方的忘川、奈河；東亞的三途川；古希臘神話中的斯提克斯河；北歐神話的吉歐爾河；美索不達米亞的胡布爾河；曼德信仰中的希特潘；還有剛果傳說中的卡倫加線。  因此「一葉舟」的造形以葉片與小舟的意象疊加而成，俯看如葉片，正視如揚帆的小舟。

content.text:
Zzzing茶憩

Inspired from tranquil and stable scenery. We apply mindfulness and combine it with the tea ceremony which got rich spiritual and cultural heritage. By using the soft color of ceramics and the natural purity of bamboo, we aims to provide a new way to relieve stress and improve one’s mental health.

靈感來自寧靜而穩定的景物。我們運用正念，将其與具有深厚精神文化底蘊的茶道相結合。以陶瓷柔和的色調、竹的自然純粹，提供一種釋放壓力健康生活的新方式。

Background | how to deal with stress and emotions ?

For the past few years, more and more people are suffering from stress and emotions. It can cause insomnia and even worse mental diseases. The Burnout they cause has also been recognized as a disease by The WHO. Taiwan even ranks second in the Global Stress Ranking. Social events caused by diseases related to mood disorders have also spread frequently these years.
近來越來越多的人受到壓力與情緒的困擾，輕則失眠；重則引發精神疾病，其導致的職業倦怠也已被WHO承認為一種疾病。台灣在全球壓力排行中甚至位居第二。情緒障礙相關疾病所致的社會事件近年也頻頻發生。

Concept

Tea ceremony is the combination of art and spirit. It refers to achieve self-cultivation by calming our mind through the art of making tea and drinking tea.  Mindfulness was historically derived from religious, now develop into a mental exercise that, when combined with some daily activities, can help to manage thought patterns and reduce stress. In recent years, mindfulness has been widely used in psychology and has been proved significantly help with stress-related illnesses. It can be practiced by focusing on the present moment and feeling every sensation during the process.  The tea ceremony involves the five senses of sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch. It is just perfectly suited to the conditions of mindfulnesszzing combines the two. One person’s tea ceremony just happens to be a time to oneself so that one can pay attention to each feeling.
茶道，是茶藝與精神的結合，指透過泡茶飲茶的藝術以沈靜心靈達到修身養性。  正念，歷史上源於宗教的冥想，現發展為一種可結合日常活動的頭腦練習，對於管理思維模式、釋放壓力有所幫助。近年來被西方心理學應用，研究證明對壓力相關的疾病有著顯著幫助。練習時需專注當下，感受過程中的每一種感覺。  茶道正包含視覺、聽覺、嗅覺、味覺、觸覺五感的體驗，精神也與正念相契合，適合練習正念的要求因此茶憩將兩者結合。一個人的茶道剛好是一段專屬於自己的時間，可以留心每一種感受。

tea ceremony + mindfulness, relax with three cups of tea.

茶道 + 正念，用三杯茶的時間放鬆一下。

We want Zzzing to be easy and relax for everyone to use so we found lots of images of tranquility and calmness as a reference, including water ripples, Japanese rock garden, Chinese round arch and so on. By making various kinds of prototypes, we synthesized visual effect and the feeling of using. Finally, here comes Zzzing with soft lines and colors using natural bamboo, matt ceramics and hand blown glass.

我們希望讓每个個人都能簡單輕鬆地使用茶憩，所以我們尋找了很多有平靜感、安定感的意象，包含水面波紋、枯山水、中式圓拱門等等，繪製並製作了多個模型，綜合視覺效果及使用握持時的感受。最終的茶憩使用了柔和的線條和顏色，材質則是選擇了天然的竹材、霧面的陶還有手工吹製的玻璃。

The Tea Pot

High temperature resistant bamboo combined with soft colored ceramic. The lid can be installed in a rotating way and water can be poured out from different directions. When pouring water, users can hold the bamboo part to prevent the heat.

耐高溫竹材與柔和色彩陶瓷相結合，壺蓋以旋轉方式安裝，水可由壺口不同方向倒出，倒水時握持竹材部分隔熱防燙。

The Tea Container and Tea Scoop

Tea container ware and Tea Scoop always used together, so we combine them and make the Tea Scoop a fixed position. The two ends of the Tea Scoop can be used respectively: dig out tea leaves when preparing and help to pour the tea leaves into the Covered Bowl. The shape of the tea container adopts the design of beveled mouth and fat bottom to gather the aroma of tea and make it easy to smell. The concave design on the higher side helps the tea to pour out.

茶倉與茶匙在使用時都會一起被用到，所以將它們結合，讓茶匙有固定位置擺放，茶匙兩端分別可用於：準備時挖出茶葉放入、倒茶葉時輔助從茶倉撥入蓋碗。茶倉的造型採用斜口及胖底收口的設計，聚集茶葉香氣，便於嗅聞，較高一邊的凹口設計幫助茶葉倒出。

The Covered Bowl

The bowl is made of double-layer glass, which can be isolated from heat when holding. The edge of the bowl is closed to a single layer, which make it easy to pour out the tea. The cover adopts Chinese round arch image and bamboo material to prevent heat.

碗身為雙層玻璃吹製而成，拿取時可隔絕熱度，碗邊收為單層，便於倒出茶水與拿取；蓋子採用中式圓拱門意象，採用竹材以防燙。

The Tea Cup

One side of the cup is concave for users to intuitively hold the cup. The cup mouth is tilted, the lower side is for sniffing and the other higher side is for drinking tea.

盞身一側的凹陷供使用者直覺性拿取，盞口傾斜，較低側可供嗅聞，另一側高起則方便飲茶。
· the three-stage heating controller & fixed heating position
· press to pull out the Waste Bowl
· the speaker design & the concave surface can collect waste water and tea

The Smart Tea Tray

Users can connect our smart tea tray to our APP while mindful tea drinking. Before and after mindfulness, the changes of users' mood can be detected and calculated through the camera. During the process, tea making steps are suggested and time is recorded. The speaker design on the edge of our tea tray can play white noise music with the scene our users chose. The heating position is slightly concave so the position of the tea pot is fixed. Our tea tray also provide three-stage heating temperature for different tea species for users to adjust.

使用者可將智慧茶盤連線app，配合正念飲茶使用，app中設置不同的放鬆情境可供選擇，正念前後可通過鏡頭偵測並運算出使用者的情緒變化，過程中提示泡茶步驟、紀錄時數。茶盤邊緣的音響設計，配合連接app選擇之情境播放白噪音音樂；加熱位置微微凹陷，固定水壺位置；針對不同茶種提供三段式加熱溫度，可供使用者調整。

Process

Blown glass, after melting glass by the high temperature of thousands of degrees, shape by blowing. The control of the fire, the accumulation of experience are bearing precious humanistic value.  3d ceramic printing, assisted by 3d printing technology, so that the modeling of clay has more possibilities.

吹製玻璃，藉由千度高溫讓玻璃融化後，吹氣塑形，其中火侯的拿捏、經驗的累積都承載了珍貴的人文價值。  3D陶瓷列印，藉由3d列印的科技輔助，讓陶土的造型有更多可能性。

On the primary level, it is a modular seating landscape that encourages communication. On the secondary level, it provides pet sanctuaries, like comforting "den" experience, reducing anxiety in busy social settings and keeping walkways clear.

The starting point of Backbone is to integrate Eastern culture into the modern living environment. It starts from the "bamboo" element. It's slim and soft, clear and straight, but restrained and low-key, a major feature is bent and not broken, broken and continuous, while born with joint, symbolizing integrity and backbone.

將東方文化融合進入現代居住環境是有骨氣的初衷，從「竹」元素出發——「竹」纖細柔美，瀟灑挺拔，但又內斂低調，一大特性就是彎而不折，折而不斷，同時又生而有節，象徵著氣節骨氣。

Therefore, both with the oriental cultural charm of bamboo and the use of modern design techniques and materials, Backbone was born, integrated, simple but not simple, suitable for a variety of styles. When you illuminate your space, you experience the perfect blend of tradition and modernity, each glance telling a story of timeless beauty and cultural reverence.

因此既帶有東方竹的文化韻味，又運用現代的設計手法及材料的這款立燈誕生了，渾然一體，簡潔但不簡單，適配多種風格。將空間被照亮，即能體驗傳統與現代的完美融合，每一眼都講述著永恆的美麗和文化崇敬的故事。

This sofa embodies the serene elegance and structural purity that are trademarks of Yamazaki's iconic designs, such as the graceful lines of the World Trade Center and the meditative space of the St. Louis Arch. Emphasizes simplicity, smooth lines and aesthetic order.   Round shape, simple lines, warm like jade, feeling warm and soft, full of Oriental Zen.

Reimagining Minoru Yamazaki’s architectural philosophy of ma—the sacred space between form and void. Let geometric precision meets organic humanity. Each piece is a meditation on ma (間), the Japanese concept of meaningful emptiness, where negative space is not absence but presence. Every curve, cut, and void tells a story of harmony between human scale and cosmic order.

c.c.Lab 嬉隙

c.c.Lab is a Coastal Cleanup system. Includes tools for picking up and collecting Marine debris, as well as a Coastal Cleanup station for storaging tools and recycling waste. Aim to guide the visitors at the beach to do something for our ocean and reduce the amount of Marine debris.

一套海邊淨灘系統設計。包含撿拾及收集海廢的工具，以及放置工具、回收垃圾的淨灘站。引導來海邊玩耍的遊客，在遊玩途中也能為海洋保護出一份力，幫助減少海廢。

Background

New UN report found that the number of species affected by marine debris has increased to 817 since 2012. Marine and coastal species are affected mostly through ingestion or entanglement. Marine debris are majority made of plastic.There are 153,400 bags, or 12.27 million liters, 646 tons of Marine debris on Taiwan's coast, which uncompressed, could fill 2,200 garbage trucks.

​​​​​​  Then we found Keelung NMMST which located beside the sea. The scenery here is attractive. At low tide when the tourists will go down the stairs to the rocky coastline, but there are a lot of Marine debris trapped in the rocks by every ebb and flood. So we hope to set up a Coastal Cleanup station equipped with some cleaning appliances and recycling devices, and let the tourists help our ocean by picking up Marine debris while playing.

聯合國報告發現，2012年以來，受海洋垃圾影響的物種已增加至817種。這些垃圾大多由塑膠製成，動物們主要受其攝入或纏繞的影響。而全臺灣的海岸上有 153,400 袋，也就是 1,227萬 公升，重量 646 噸的海廢垃圾，在未壓縮的情況下可裝滿 2,200 臺垃圾車。  於是我們找到了位在臺灣基隆海邊的海科館，它附設的公園風景優美，在退潮時遊客們會走下階梯到岩岸嬉戲，但在美的風景中每次的漲退潮卻都帶來許多的垃圾卡在岩石之中，因此我們希望在這設立一個淨灘站，配置一些淨灘所需的用具及回收裝置，讓遊客們在嬉戲的過程中也能順便撿拾垃圾幫助海洋。

A marine debris picker. Marine debris often gets stuck in crevices between the rocks on rocky shores at low tide, so Crevices Picker design into a thin long shape, in addition to picking up the basic garbage on the ground, but also like toothpick cleaning teeth, deep in the gap to pick up garbage. It's so simple to use that anyone can use it intuitively.

與寵物共食餐桌設計。現今社會寵物在家庭中的地位如同家人一般，外出用餐時也常一同跟隨，尤其是狗狗，共食餐桌希望讓寵物在餐廳用餐時也能像客人一樣受到招待，和主人一起享受服務，給主人與寵物不一樣的共餐體驗。

Background

Under the influence of urbanization and family centralization, the relationship between people becomes weak, and the status of pets is increasingly elevated, becoming people's important emotional sustenance: pets are no longer just pets, they are intimate companions. According to statistics, there are about 1.3 million pet dogs and 350,000 pet cats in Taiwan, with an estimated annual output value of more than NT $12 billion. Hence the rise of pet-friendly restaurants, which allow families with pets to dine with their furry children. In pet-friendly restaurants, furry children are also guests, eat together !hoping to let pets and owners both enjoy the meal through design.

在城市化及家庭核心化的影響下，人與人之間的關係變得淡薄，寵物地位日益提升，成為了人們情感上的寄託 : 寵物不再只是寵物，牠們是親密的伴侶。根據統計，台灣寵物犬約有 130 萬隻，寵物貓約 35 萬，粗估每年約有新台幣 120 億元以上產值。因此，寵物友善餐廳興起，讓有飼養寵物的家庭能夠帶著毛小孩一起用餐。在寵物友善餐廳，毛小孩們也一樣是客人，希望通過共食餐桌讓寵物與主人都能一同享受用餐。

Considering that most of the pets willing to go out and eat with their owners are dogs, eat together !’s users are mainly dogs. There is a big difference in size between dog breeds, so the pet part of eat together ! can be adjusted so that each furry child can eat comfortably. Furry children have different personalities just like us, considering that there may be lively and social ones or also be timid territorial or aggressive ones, eat together ! takes care of each dog's needs. Above all, eat together ! hopes to reduce the sense of class between owners and pets, and increase the sense of harmony and the sense of ceremony of dining out.

考量多數願意同主人外出用餐的寵物多為狗狗，共食餐桌的使用者主要針對狗狗們。而不同種類的狗狗體型差異較大，因此共食餐桌的寵物部分具備可調節的功能，讓每隻毛小孩都能舒服地用餐。毛小孩們跟我們一樣性格也各不相同，考慮到會有活潑熱愛社交的；也會有膽小具領域性或攻擊性的，共食餐桌也照顧每隻狗狗的需求。最重要的是，共食餐桌希望減少主人與寵物之間的階級感受，增加共桌共食的和睦感及外出用餐的儀式感。

Recharge｜anaesthetic for soul

We're all polyphasic sleepers, and we use many odd times in our lives other than the time we sleep at night: closing our eyes to rest, napping... We call them recharge, and we want to design for these recharge moments.

Bus, MRT, train, plane, desk, sitting, standing, whenever and wherever you want to sleep!

我們都是多階段睡眠者，除了晚上的睡覺時間外，我們會利用生活中的許多時刻：閉目養神、打盹、午休…… 我們稱它們為充電，希望為這些充電時刻而設計。

公車、捷運、火車、飛機、桌上、坐著、站著，隨時隨地想睡就睡！

Background

The energy we expend can be repaired and rebuild at rest. It also makes us more creative, athletic and better memory, and has been linked to a host of health problems. Different people need different amounts of sleep, including: Short sleepers (4-6 h), average sleepers (7-8 h), and long sleepers (more than 9 h). However, according to a survey byTaiwan MOHW, people over 15 years of age only sleep 6.9 hours per night on average. Therefore, it is important to take a nap at odd times.

我們所消耗的精力，會在休息時進行修補、替換、重建。同時讓我們更具創造力、運動能力及記憶力，還與許多健康問題相關。而不同人所需睡眠時間也不同，分為：短睡眠者（不足 4 h / 4-6 h）、一般睡眠者（7-8 h）、長睡眠者（ 9 h / 9 h以上），但據台灣健康署調查，全國 15 以上之國民每晚平均只睡到 6.9 小時，因此能夠隨時隨地小憩就變得很重要。

Recharge aims at the problems encountered in commuting, which can be stored and carried easily; Adjustable use, suitable for everyone, no sense of suffocation; Fit our user's body, fix their neck and support their head, so that the shoulder and neck will no longer ache; When the air conditioning is too strong, you can take out the hat and no more sleep headaches; Also with Sucker can be easy disassembly, it can be adsorbed on the seat of smooth material to assist fixation, and it can also adsorb on the window to take a rest while standing.

充電哲學的設計理念針對通勤中常遇到的問題，可收納便於攜帶；可調節使用，適合每個人，不會有窒息感；貼和使用者身體，固定頸部並給頭以倚靠，讓肩頸不再痠痛；在冷氣太強時可以拿出帽子，不會再睡到頭痛；還附有吸盤可供輕鬆拆裝，吸附在光滑材質的座位上可輔助固定，站著時也能吸附在窗戶上稍作休息。

A fishing gear designed for kids. Hope to add more fun through our design, let the kids more interested in going out to participate in fishing activities.

為兒童設計的漁具。希望增添更多使用的樂趣，通過設計讓孩子們更有興趣走出戶外參加釣魚的活動。

Background

Nowadays, with the rapid modernization of society and the urbanization phenomenon, more and more children have the lack of nature. It is important to guide kids to participate in more outdoor activities and contact with nature. Fishing related research shows that most of this activity is carried out in groups, with children accounting for 37.5 %. Compared with other age groups, fishing in childhood is the most popular, and the number of children and youth involved in fishing has increased each year. So I want to make fishing more simple and also add more fun to attract more kids participate in this activity through design.

現今社會現代化迅速，都市化現象導致越來越多孩子存在大自然缺失，引導孩子們更多地參與戶外活動接觸大自然變得很重要。相關研究顯示，釣魚這項活動大多會結伴而行，其中兒童佔37.5%，相較於其他年齡段，釣魚在孩童時期最受歡迎，每年參與釣魚活動的兒童及青少年皆有增長，因此我們想從漁具進行設計，讓釣魚更簡單，也為釣魚增添更多樂趣，吸引更多孩子參與這項活動。

When a beginner unhooks are often panicked, sometimes unable to reach the hook with their hands, and it is also difficult to use ordinary pliers.

新手脫鉤時常很慌張，有時用手並無法抓到鉤子，而使用普通鉗子也較為困難

Since it is for kids, I hope to improve the convenience of using: the front of the pliers is round and curved, so it is safer and easier to control; Press up and down to control the left and right closed pliers, so that the rotation of the wrist is more natural when using; When released, the spring springs back and the pliers return to open state, make it easier to use; The shape of the handle conforms to the shape of the hand when holding it, and both hands can be used.

由於是給小朋友使用，所以希望改善使用的便利性：鉗子前端是圓潤彎曲的，更安全且容易控制住魚鉤，不易滑掉；上下按壓控制左右閉合的鉗子，讓使用時手腕的轉動更為自然；放鬆時彈簧回彈，鉗子恢復張開狀態，讓使用更輕鬆；握柄造形順應握持時手的形狀，左右手都可使用。​​​​​​​

The lovely whale shape creates a movable whale jaw under the premise of comfortably holding, hoping to make the kids who are not interested in fishing also have fun while fishing!​​​​​​​

可愛的鯨魚造型，在握持舒適的前提下塑造出鯨魚動下巴的型態，希望讓原本對釣魚不那麼感興趣的小朋友也能在釣魚時獲得樂趣！​​​​​​​

We took our model to the fishing place for testing. During the process, we happened to meet a family also came here to play, so we asked the kids to try out our model and recorded his feedback.

content.text:
A stationery set designed for kids with ADHD. There’re round 5-7% kids in the world are diagnosed with ADHD. These kids have lots of problems when they go to school. Minder wants to help them with design by starting with things around them.

一套為ADHD兒童設計的文具組。在全球約有5–7%的兒童確診ADHD，這些孩子們在上學時會遇到很多問題，Minder希望通過從孩子身邊的物件著手，用設計幫助他們。

content.alt: Learning aids for kids with ADHD | Minder — image 5
Learning aids for kids with ADHD | Minder — image 6

content.text:
Background

In recent years, the prevalence of various mental disorders among kids and teenagers in Taiwan has increased. In order of prevalence, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is the highest, and there are 1-2 kids with ADHD in an average class. In Asia, the prevalence rate of ADHD among nonages is also between 6-8%.

近年來，台灣兒童及青少年各種心理疾病之比例增加，依盛行率的高低排序，以注意力不足過動症（ADHD）為最高，平均一個普通班級會有1-2位注意力不足過動症的兒童，在亞洲，未成年之ADHD流行率也均介於6-8%之間。

content.alt: Learning aids for kids with ADHD | Minder — image 8
Learning aids for kids with ADHD | Minder — image 9

content.text:
For ADHD children with organization and seriation problem.

In our interview survey, the teacher of the classroom in charge of ADHD children in primary school said, "We hope that the things on their desk are as simple as possible, and things should be fixed; we will ask parents to prepare transparent pen boxes for them, and only put necessities in it."

Therefore, our design clearly distinguishes the position of different stationery. When arranging the pencil case, we put each stationery back to its own position. When fasten the pencil case, the light will be on for encouragement when each stationery is in its position. When some of the stationery is missing the light will flash for warning. It can be combined with other Minder smart stationery to help ADHD children collect all stationery well.

針對有排序組織功能問題的ADHD兒童。

在走訪調查中，國小負責ADHD孩子的學習教室老師表示：「希望他們桌上的東西越簡單越好，東西要有固定性；會要求希望家長為他們準備透明的筆盒，裡面只放必需品就好。」

因此我們的設計明確區分不同文具的位置，整理筆盒時把每個文具放回自己的位置，扣上後，每個文具都歸位則亮燈鼓勵；有缺失則閃燈警示。可配合智慧文具，幫助ADHD兒童收好所有的文具。

content.alt: Learning aids for kids with ADHD | Minder — image 11

content.text:
For sensation-seeking problem in children with ADHD.

The button above the eraser can be slid for express energy when kids are not focused, and the difficulty of sliding the button will gradually increase until they become immovable.

Apply Pendulum exercise and Regulation game which from sensation-seeking therapies.

針對有感覺尋求問題的ADHD兒童。

橡皮擦上方的按鍵在孩子不專注時，可供滑動抒發能量，按鍵的滑動難度會緩緩增加直至滑不動。

應用感覺尋求的療法中的鐘擺動作（通過重複做一件有韻律又重複的事，慢慢專注）和調節遊戲（幫助孩子較快地進行一項活動，然後放慢速度，越來越慢）。

content.alt: Learning aids for kids with ADHD | Minder — image 13

content.text:
For ADHD children with sensation-seeking and fine motor skills problems.

The shape of the pencil guides kids to hold it properly. The Pendulum exercise and Regulation game are also applied, and the virtual button technology is used. When kids are not focused, they can press to express the energy. When pressing, the feedback strength is from strong to weak until it cannot be pressed, helping the kids to release. For as much as possible to reduce frequent press core out distracting them, we adopt 1.4mm pen core and rotating core out method .

針對有感覺尋求問題、精細運動障礙的ADHD兒童。
筆的形狀引導孩子正確握筆 。同樣應用鐘擺動作與調節遊戲， 使用虛擬按鈕技術，在不專注時，可按壓抒發能量，按壓時反饋力度由強到弱直到無法按壓，幫助孩子舒緩及釋放。 採1.4mm筆芯及旋轉的出芯方式，盡可能減少頻繁按動出芯分散孩子的注意力。

content.text:
UI design

Our app is divided into ADHD children and parents/teachers/therapists two sides. Children can use the device at home. They can choose a music they liked and follow the rhythm, shake Minder Pencil and press the button to increase activity or conduct the therapist's therapy. The parent/teacher/therapist side can read the child's usage at school to understand the child's concentration condition.

分為 ADHD 孩童以及父母/老師/治療師兩端，孩童端可在家中使用，可選擇音樂跟隨節奏晃動Minder pencil以及按壓按鍵，以此增加活動量或配合治療師的療法進行遊戲；父母/老師/治療師端則是可以讀取孩子在學校個時段的使用情況，以此了解孩子在學校的專注情況。
